item.title: Trump's Iran decision could set Israel's election date
item.description:
Sources in the political system who spoke with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in recent days came away with the impression that he is leaning toward changing his decision to hold the election as scheduled on Oct. 27 and instead move it up to Sept. 1. Accordingly, the Likud primaries would be held in early July. […]
